hints.title: Generate Target Permutation
hints.text: Apply standard next permutation k times to compute the target string.

hints.title: Greedy Left to Right Alignment
hints.text: For each position i from 0 to n - 1, locate the matching character in the original array.

hints.title: Adjacent Bubble Swaps
hints.text: Shift the matched character back to index i using adjacent swaps, incrementing the total swap count.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth search over all string permutations explores an exponential number of states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating the target via k next permutations plus greedy bubble swapping runs in O(k * n + n^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate repeats next permutation k times and applies greedy adjacent swap counting.
